Hula turned "I'd go if someone came with me" into a plan. Discover what's happening nearby, find someone to go with, and show up together.
Consumer social · iOS & Android
01 · The problem

Ever skipped an event because you had no one to go with?

Hula is a consumer social app that helped people discover local events and actually show up, together. As the founding designer, I took it from zero to one, owning the experience end-to-end and partnering closely with a small engineering team to ship.

Our sharpest product call: launch in a single high-density city (NYC), so a match could become a coffee across the street, not a two-hour trek.

The bet
Launch in one dense city, so a match could become an art show hang across the street, not a two-hour trek.
02 · My role

Founding designer, end to end. From first sketch to a shipped native app.

I owned the whole experience, discovery, matching, and the moment two people commit to showing up, and worked shoulder to shoulder with a small engineering team to ship it on iOS and Android.

03 · Outcome

Grew to ~8,000 daily active users.

A single-city launch let the product prove the core loop where it mattered most: real people, real events, actually meeting up.
